title: Pi Brave browser profile aliases
description: Identity-free contract for local aliases. Values are resolved against Brave Local State at runtime.

profiles.description: Alias names are operator-facing and are not profile directory names.

profileDirectory.description: Exact directory key expected in Brave Local State profile.info_cache.

userDataDir.description: Optional configured Brave root; it is verified against Local State before launch.

extensionsExpected.description: When true, enabled mode requires an observable chrome-extension:// runtime target.
